    - Ah! You recognise me, of course. Percival, leading man of the Gilded Stage. And you are *Player*? Splendid. I am practising asking about other people. How am I doing?

    - A ropemaker's son at seventeen, with a good voice and no money. Six years of carrying spears and dying in the first act.
    - Then a leading man broke his ankle on a staircase and I went on. Kings, lost heirs, three founders of the kingdom since. [Lavinia](../npcs/lavinia.md) lured me here with the best parts. She has kept her promise.
    - The Savage warrior in the new play. He stands for the whole front line that held the Balrog at the Tree while the Magicians wove the seal.
    - I have read every account of the Last Stand the Academy will lend an actor, and none of them agree. I have even watched the Midbarium envoys walk across the plaza. Twice.
    - Rosamund. Ten years of quarrelling, since one entrance in one rehearsal. The audiences adore it, and Lavinia sells tickets on it.
    - She will not share a stage with me, and the Last Stand needs us both. I have thought of asking her what she would need from me. I have not. Yet. I am working on it.
    - Farewell! Did you see the cloak? I did not mean to swirl it. It simply happens.
    - I did not swirl the cloak once in her scene. Not once. She looked at me as if I were a stranger. It was wonderful.
